macros.name: closeexport
macros.doc: The command \closeexport terminates a sequence of exportations by closing the file and announcing.

macros.name: ExportArrayParams
macros.doc: This macro is just a list of exportations of the lengths and parameters defining the layout in array and tabular environments.

macros.name: ExportIf
macros.doc: \ExportIf allows you to export the state of an “if” condition, i.e. the command \ExportIf{foo} will export the state of \iffoo, just by writing \foofalse or \footrue in the export file.

macros.name: ExportPageLayout
macros.doc: If you want to export all the dimensions (lengths) describing the page layout, just use the \ExportPageLayout command.

macros.name: ExportParameter
macros.doc: \ExportParameter allows you to export parameters defined by simple commands, like \textfraction.

macros.name: Import
macros.doc: Importing the data is easy: open the file for reading, read it: the \setcounter and \setlength commands are executed, then close it.
